Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Look: green saree

Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
4. Zoya - 10 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rohan stands in the park. Anita, Ananya and Ishaan stand near him.]

Anita: "Rohan, what's the plan today?"

[Rohan catches the ball.]

Anita: "Okay, Ananya."

[Rohan plays with his dog.]

Ananya: "What a day to remember!"
